assertions: Public comphelper WeakComponentImplHelper/Base and WeakImplHelper/Base retain distinct native namespaces, complete query/template/type-list contracts, shared actual UnoImplBase disposed field, late-listener/failure behavior and explicit destructor-only cleanup. Public container4 retains its own lazy DEFAULT and reverse COW snapshots, complete moves, matching-Context disposed removal and extra exceptionFunc overloads. The original catch-by-value Exception parameter is an actual base value while a single platform-neutral compiler catch scope preserves the original dynamic thrown value for zero-argument getCaughtException; only the injected host execution ABI remains browser-owned. Existing internal URE copies are unchanged. Physical virtual inheritance, mutex/native shared-memory interleavings, noexcept process termination and allocator/shutdown traces remain unqualified. Real metadata/property-bag, URI providers and complete DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unfinished.

gaps: Physical C++ virtual inheritance, native threading, noexcept termination and allocation/shutdown remain unqualified.
